text: 市场监管总局今天（29日）公布数据显示，上半年，全国新设外商投资企业3.5万户，同比增长7.0%。 从投资区域看，出口大省、沿边省份外商投资企业增长“双轮驱动”。上半年，海南、山东、广东、江苏等出口大省新设外商投资企业增速分别为38.6%、15.2%、8.1%、6.8%；黑龙江、内蒙古、广西、吉林等沿边省份新设外商投资企业增速分别达到79.5%、29.1%、16.6%、12.0%。（央视）
text_en: Data released by the State Administration for Market Regulation today (29th) show that in the first half, 35,000 new foreign-invested enterprises were registered nationwide, up 7.0% year on year. By investment region, export-heavy provinces and border provinces drove growth in new foreign-invested enterprises. In H1, Hainan, Shandong, Guangdong, and Jiangsu saw growth of 38.6%, 15.2%, 8.1%, and 6.8%, respectively, while border provinces like Heilongjiang, Inner Mongolia, Guangxi, and Jilin posted growth of 79.5%, 29.1%, 16.6%, and 12.0%. (CCTV)
